notes.title: Engine Updates & Performance Improvements, Small Fixes
notes.content:
We finally updated the engine in preperation for all the great new features that are about to come soon.


 Updated to Unity 6
 Updated input system
 Fixed missing wood material for wooden elevator 
 Performance improvements


Thanks to all the bug reports that you have sent.
If you encounter any other problems please let us know.

Cheers,
Wolfgang & the Team

notes.title: The Outro
notes.content:
It's finally here: The final cutscene and conclusion of the VR Giants story.

Sorry for the slight delay we had, but finishing content and features always takes a bit more time to really make it shine. But here it is, and we really hope you like it. ✨

I don't want to show too much so I don't take away your motivation to finish the game, but guess who's back to round everything up? The creator!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544271/0d4499b8ac1f9ea3ce3d8ad2447488ef46f38a16.gif

Of course, our heroes are also there!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544271/aafc8150b025d01be8449b1e7a9bf98d9c81329b.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544271/c1a19b66d94afd322cbb53711632fbe08abc4252.gif

And we wouldn't want to miss the sheep, would we?
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544271/07c41768931b32844c361edf7afde1349e54a5bc.gif

But as always, not everything goes as planned.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544271/6bf94af475b27374ed1b5a7de5df3f4a3c2f2a16.gif

Pro Tip: Did you know your last collected costumes will be included in the Outro? Yes, it's true! So play it with the most hilarious costumes you can find and post a picture or send it to us.

About the creation progress:
It took us almost 9 months to get the outro right. Besides the actual work of recording, animating, and cutting the whole scene, the concept phase took a lot of effort. My intention was to close the current storyline in a satisfying way while still hinting at possible future content (no confirmation made here - just dreaming big). I hope you like how we solved it.

Please let us know in the comments how you like it.

Discord Community:
As always, I want to invite you to our Discord to share your experiences with VR Giants, talk to us, or get help from our community. Join our Discord

Bug Reporting Tool:
Last time, we let you know about our new Bug Reporting tool. We have already received many helpful bug reports. Please keep using it and help us make VR Giants a better game. Thanks to everyone who has submitted a bug! ❤️

Is this the End?: No, definitely not!
The storyline might have concluded with the current update, but we are far from done with VR Giants. I don't want to reveal too much in this update, but sometime in Q1 next year, I will let you in on our plans and what's coming for VR Giants... and I promise it's a biggie!

So don't forget to comment on how you like the outro.

🌟🎄 We wish you a wonderful holiday season 🌟🎄

Wolfgang and the Team

notes.title: The Final Level
notes.content:
The Final Level: All Good Things...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544271/2b8ebcd341c00c331c587da74abdd7430c839bb1.gif

It is finally here. The last level you will face in VR Giants. And we made it a really long experience with many new challenges, a beautiful view, and a massive scale. If you want to finish the level in one go, please plan to spend at least an hour in VR, so make sure all your controllers are charged and you don't have anything else that could interrupt you. You can expect the following:

•  Flying on Clouds
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544271/def93919b9f448e61dbf7a854b2b02fa7a48f6a5.gif

•  Building unstable pathways with wood
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544271/13d550ee0c54546bc0c111b39fe77541b5d574ab.gif

•  Classic Lava Goliath and Fireball challenges
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544271/a83b97d70cf7d17169b0b4c3c508fbd5798b6951.gif

•  Dramatic wood block catapulting and many more fun activities...

Bug Report Tool

We finally have a bug reporting tool! Please use it whenever you encounter a bug so we can fix and polish everything to make the game shine. It's located in every menu. Your reports help us a lot.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544271/22977528c3e428c02fcf186073ea08d98d5bff26.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544271/5b7840bf86f2d50461bd0685c129b62898902547.jpg

Please be patient when sending a bug report. We don't have a progress bar yet and it may take a couple of minutes depending on your internet connection.

What about the Outro?

It's almost done. We originally meant to publish it together with the last level, but unfortunately, it would have meant that we had to delay the level launch again. So you get the last level now and the outro in a couple of days or weeks.

Stay tuned for many more great updates to come, some smaller ones before New Year's and some really big ones in 2025 (really big stuff is happening behind the scenes).

Cheers,

Wolfgang & Risa Interactive Team

notes.title: New Ice Level Out!
notes.content:
Iceland Hopping
We added a really long new ice level to the game. This will be one of the two final levels added to VR Giants. Just like the last two levels, which we added before Christmas, the level is longer and less linear than the previous levels. So, expect a playing time of about 90 minutes for this one and the following actions:

Build floating bridges for David
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544271/b45dbb43632106abc4edef08578fa6321211a081.gif


Shoot David up in the sky
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544271/b39602e84afc5425c359277b9acaa0445b56a05e.gif


Use high speed slides for ski jumps
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544271/1f5c46becace3b883ffe0827763aa7e25e77b7a6.gif

Create new stairways with sticky cubes
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544271/bb249b5357bdb2a16857aa8676487f773ecebf39.gif


Improvements:

 Fixed light baking for button rings.
 Improved performance by moving more meshes to static.
 Fixed loading screen cutoff for some aspect ratios.

notes.title: New Levels are out!
notes.content:
New Levels
We have added two new levels with 7 sections spread across 3 different biomes. You can find them in the Fluff after lifting up David to the next cloud plateau.

Here is a small preview:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35544271/81f23f9d293d9223a16211b358c0f731a0f74277.gif


Bug Fixes

 Fixed issues with some USB input devices freezing movement in the game.
 Fixed issues with some audio devices freezing the start screen.
 Implemented a new system to prevent hands from getting stuck inside geometry when teleporting.
 Added new LODs to improve performance on some systems.

notes.title: Added Locomotion, more VR Settings, Improved David Camera and more...
notes.content:
After many requests, we have finally added some new features, such as:

Locomotion:
[olist]
 You now only need 1x1m of space.
 Use the thumbstick/touchpad to move and rotate.
 Press the thumbstick/touchpad to crouch/stand up.
[/olist]
In Settings:

 Enable or disable movement, rotation, and crouching.
 Choose movement speed.
 Choose vignette visibility.
 Choose left or right hand for rotation/movement.


Body Height Adjustment:
You can adjust the VR player's height in the settings, which is very helpful when playing with kids.

David Camera:
The camera now provides a better view of the direction you are walking towards.

Desert Level:
The sun no longer damages you when you move between the shadows of Goliath's fingers.

notes.title: Big Performance Improvement for Cyrillic Languages
notes.content:
Previously players using screen languages that included Cyrillic letters had 30%-60% less frames.
Now we finally found the bug and fixed it.

In case you still encounter performance issues with hardware above our minimum required, please contact us in the community discussion and let us know so we can fix it next.

Up next: new features and price changes
We fixed fixed most mature bugs and are about to release some cool new features next. 
We also wanted to inform you about an upcoming price increase, so please consider securing your copy at the current pricing while you still can.

notes.title: Performance Fixes in Fluff (Level Selection)
notes.content:
Fixed several sources for bad performance on some systems


 Added LODs
 Reduced unnecessary tessellation
 Fixed bad shader performance
 More objects now in static batching

notes.title: Fixed: OpenXR Crashes with Vive Console + problems for VoiceMeeter users
notes.content:
Vive Console Bug Fixed:
- Player is asked to choose his preferred OpenXR runtime on first start up. Vive Console is not supported but Vive users can now manually choose SteamVR as working runtime.
- Open XR runtime can be changed via settings (restart required)

VoiceMeeter problems fixed:
- User of VoiceMeeter were stuck in "press any button" screen.
- TO US VOICEMEETER: start VR Giants with VoiceMeeter App closed, and start VoiceMeeter after your in Main Menu. See our discord channel to find more help.

notes.title: Added Rewatching Intro & Fixed Intro Subtitles for some Languages
notes.content:
- Previously missing letters are now shown in Russian, Ukrainian and Asian Languages
- Intro replays if no sheep was collected, and "Rewatch Intro" button is added to main menu

notes.title: Fixed Asian Languages & Vibration
notes.content:
Asian Languages now show all letters properly 
 Unintended vibrations are now fixed
